1.title: Trekking Nymeján 4 Days
1.description: Deep immersion in the Sierra Nevada of Santa Marta through challenging trails, sacred waterfalls, and authentic encounters with indigenous communities.
1.longDescription:
Embark on a deep immersion in the Sierra Nevada of Santa Marta, where lush nature blends with the rich cultural heritage of indigenous communities. This trek will take you through challenging trails, stunning landscapes, and authentic encounters with guardians of tradition, offering you a unique perspective on life in the Colombian mountains. Discover sacred waterfalls, learn about ancestral cosmovision, and let yourself be enveloped by the magic of a natural and cultural paradise.

DAY 1 | The Andean Awakening and the Wimake Roots
At 05:30 AM the adventure begins with hotel pickup in a 4×4 vehicle. Route through Minca enjoying the sunrise and the aroma of coffee plantations. Breakfast in Punta Brava in front of the iconic Colombian shield made of clay. Descent to the Boquerón Lookout with views of the Guachaca Canyon and a 3-hour hike to the Wimake Indigenous Community. Lunch with Lorenzo and Cecilia, where you will learn about their cosmovision and traditional constructions. If weather permits, swim in a natural pool. Community dinner with knowledge exchange and rest in a hammock.

DAY 2 | Jungle Challenge and Countryside Warmth
Indigenous breakfast and group photo with the community. Demanding uphill hike under the heat and humidity of the tropical forest. Observation of giant trees and local wildlife. Refreshing swim in the natural pool before the finish line. Arrival at "Los Jaguares", where Pablo and his family will welcome you with countryside lunch, coffee or herbal tea. Shared dinner and rest on a comfortable bed.

DAY 3 | Sacred Waterfalls and Earth Traditions
At 06:30 AM, ascent through original stone steps carved by the Tayrona. Ritual bath at Poza Azul and arrival at the imposing Salto Nymeján (100 meters of sacred fall). Offering to Mother Earth. Visit to the Honey Waterfall to learn the artisanal process of sugarcane. Pass through the Coffee Waterfall. Arrival at the "Palace of the Clouds" where Lenin and Antonio will welcome you with lunch. Afternoon of coffee, story sharing and rest.

DAY 4 | The Roof of the World and the Return to the Sea
At 06:00 AM, the most demanding section to reach the maximum altitude of 2,220 m.a.s.l. with unparalleled panoramic views. At Granja La Lujana, countryside breakfast with Yesid and Milena, immersion in dairy culture and the cheese-making process. Descent through the Cloud Forest among epiphytic plants. Return in 4×4 (2.5 hours) enjoying the colors of the sunset to your hotel in Santa Marta.

Includes: 4×4 transport and motorcycle return, travel insurance, local guides, fruit and snacks during breaks, accommodation and meals for 4 days.

Does not include: Alcoholic beverages, mineral water, handicrafts, services not included in the tour, flights.

2.title: Palace of the Clouds 3 Days
2.description: Unforgettable adventure where the magic of the Sierra Nevada will take your breath away. From sunrises in Minca to dreamy waterfalls and viewpoints.
2.longDescription:
Immerse yourself in an unforgettable adventure where the magic of the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta will take your breath away. From sunrise in Minca to the imposing waterfalls and dreamy viewpoints, every step will reveal stunning landscapes, cloud forests, and the warmth of its communities. Enjoy the best organic coffee in front of glaciers, rest in hammocks under the mountain sky, and let yourself be enveloped by the sacred energy of waterfalls like Aluna and Velo de Novia.

DAY 1 | Ascent to the Heights and Panoramic Views
Your adventure begins with a 4×4 pickup directly from your hotel. The journey takes you through Minca, the ecological capital, where the aroma of coffee plantations will envelop you. We ascend along a steep road with stunning views of the city of Santa Marta and the Ciénaga lagoon system, until we reach Hostal de Moncho at 2,800 meters above sea level. After a delicious coffee and light breakfast, you will embark on a trek of approximately 5 hours. You will enjoy a 360° view of the impressive Sierra Nevada, while on one side you can see the city and Tayrona National Park. Keep your eyes open to spot endemic birds. You will reach Cerro Kennedy, at 3,060 meters high, from where you will begin a descent to Hostal Altos de la Sierra. There you will enjoy lunch and a campfire at sunset.

DAY 2 | Magical Sunrise, Waterfalls, and the Palace of the Clouds
The second day awaits you with a dreamlike sunrise, perfect for capturing the best selfie in front of the impressive glaciers. A good coffee and a delicious breakfast will give you the energy needed to begin the descent through a sub-andean mountain forest, with lush vegetation and unparalleled bird richness, including the quetzal. We travel a steep trail through thick jungle until we find the majestic Aluna Waterfall, where you can enjoy its impressive veil of water. Then, an ascent of approximately one kilometer to the Palace of the Clouds. There, Lenin, your host, will welcome you with lunch and a comfortable room. The afternoon will be dedicated to sharing with Lenin's family, ending with a campfire and dinner in the cozy dining room.

DAY 3 | Canyons, Waterfalls, and Return to Civilization
The last day begins with coffee and toast, but not before taking a selfie with Lenin's family and their pets in front of the glaciers and the beautiful garden of the Palace of the Clouds. You will begin the ascent through a meadow of bridle trails with infinite views toward the great Guachaca Canyon. You will appreciate waterfalls, mountains, and bird songs until you reach the summit at 2,200 meters. With luck, you may glimpse Tayrona National Park and its beaches. You will arrive at Granja La Lujana to meet Yesid and Milena, who will welcome you with a delicious breakfast. After a pause, we continue descending to Velo de Novia Waterfall to refresh your spirit. Lunch at Granja Corea, surrounded by coffee plantations and the warm attention of Don Juan and his family. The journey ends with a three-kilometer ride on an enduro motorcycle to Bonda, where a taxi will take you to your hotel.

Includes: 4×4 transport for groups over 5 people and personalized motorcycle transport, travel insurance for 3 days, accommodation 2 nights, meals (3 breakfasts, 3 lunches, 2 dinners), fruit and snacks during the hike, indigenous or local guide and interpreter if required.

Does not include: Alcoholic beverages, mineral water, handicrafts, flights.

3.title: Bunkuany Adventure 3 Days
3.description: Colombia's little Lost City. 3 days of cultural immersion with indigenous communities and virgin nature in the Sierra Nevada.
3.longDescription:
Immerse yourself in a transformative 3-day experience at Colombia's "little Lost City". Designed for adventurers seeking a deep connection with nature and ancestral wisdom, this tour takes you to the heart of the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta. You will travel ancestral trails surrounded by unique biodiversity, enjoy organic coffee grown on the mountainsides, and experience moments of spiritual connection at sacred sites of the Tayrona culture.

DAY 1 | The Beginning of the Adventure
At 08:00 AM, pickup at your accommodation in Santa Marta. At 09:00 AM, brief stop at the office in Bonda to store extra luggage and enjoy a coffee before starting the trek. 25-minute vehicle ride to the starting point. At 09:40 AM, 1-hour hike (3 km) through the tropical forest to reach the Piedra de Donama. At 11:00 AM, arrival at Río La Lisa: a space to swim, relax, and enjoy the crystal-clear mountain waters. Traditional lunch served at Casa Domek. At 02:00 PM, 3-hour hike (6 km) to La Playita, a local self-sustainable farm in the mountains. Dinner prepared by the host family. Overnight in beds.

DAY 2 | Toward the Lost City of Bunkuany
At 08:00 AM, traditional breakfast with local farm products. At 08:30 AM, morning hike of 3.5 hours (8 km) to the archaeological site of Bunkuany, venturing deep into the Sierra Nevada. At 11:30 AM, guided tour focused on the history of the ruins and their cultural significance. Lunch at Restaurante Bunkuany. At 02:00 PM, 2.5-hour hike (2 km) to Calabazo through the tropical forest; an ideal opportunity to spot monkeys, birds, rivers, and impressive jungle landscapes. At 04:30 PM, arrival at Calabazo to enjoy a cold drink. At 04:45 PM, 1.5-hour hike (3 km) to the Kogui Village, our second campsite. Dinner and campfire.

DAY 3 | Cultural Immersion and Return
At 07:45 AM, 500-meter hike to a nearby lookout to appreciate the spectacular views of the snow-capped peaks of the Sierra Nevada. At 08:15 AM, traditional breakfast. At 09:00 AM, cultural tour led by an indigenous guide, offering a deep understanding of Kogui traditions, their spirituality, daily life, and cosmovision. At 12:30 PM, lunch and descent: 3 km hike back to Calabazo. At 02:00 PM, transportation back to Santa Marta.

Includes: Full meals (3 breakfasts, 3 lunches, 2 dinners), camping area accommodation, local expert guide.

Does not include: Alcoholic beverages, mineral water, handicrafts, flights.

4.title: Lost City 4 Days
4.description: 4 days to one of the oldest archaeological sites in Latin America. Trekking through jungle, rivers, and indigenous communities in the Sierra Nevada.
4.longDescription:
Designed for those in optimal physical condition, this trek involves daily hikes of up to 7 hours through dense jungle trails, river crossings, and steep mountain terrain, leading to one of the oldest archaeological sites in Latin America: the Lost City. The Lost City Tour is not just a physical challenge, but also a profound cultural and spiritual connection experience. The place is amazing, but the journey itself is equally impactful.

DAY 1 | First Stage: 10 KM
The adventure begins at 9:00 a.m., when a 4×4 vehicle will pick you up at your hotel. From there, we will travel for 2.5 hours along the Troncal del Caribe, enjoying picturesque landscapes until we reach the town of El Mamey, the official starting and finishing point of the trek. Upon arrival, we will replenish our energy with a typical lunch. After lunch, we will begin the first hike of approximately 10 kilometers (4 hours of walking). The route follows a clear trail with little shade and some steep sections, so it is essential to stay hydrated, use sunscreen, and wear a hat. We will arrive at Campamento Adán around 4:30 p.m. If weather permits, we will enjoy a refreshing swim in a nearby natural pool before dinner.

DAY 2 | From Camp 1 to Camp 3
The second day begins at dawn, waking at 5:00 a.m. with the first light of day illuminating the mountains. After an energizing breakfast, we set out on the route with two trekking sections, totaling 18 kilometers. The first section, 9 kilometers, takes us deep into the tropical rainforest. We will cross lush vegetation and arrive at Mutanzhi, an indigenous village where our guide will share fascinating stories about the traditions, beliefs, and lifestyle of this ancestral community. After this enriching visit, we will continue to Campamento Mumake, where a comforting lunch awaits us.

DAY 3 | Lost City
This third day marks the climax of the expedition. After a comforting breakfast, we set out toward the archaeological heart of Lost City. The morning hike covers 4 kilometers following the river course. Then, we face the ascent of 1,200 stone steps, built centuries ago by the Tayrona, the civilization that inhabited this sacred place. With each step, the jungle reveals ancient terraces and stone structures. We will dedicate approximately 3 hours to explore this indigenous sanctuary, where our guide will reveal its historical significance and spiritual connection with ancestral communities. After experiencing the magic of Lost City, we descend 1 kilometer to Paso Lorenzo for lunch. Then, 10 kilometers (approximately 3 hours) back to Campamento Mumake.

DAY 4 | Camp 2 - El Mamey (End of Journey)
The last day begins at dawn, with an energizing breakfast that prepares us for the final stretch. We have 18 kilometers of hiking divided into two stages. First stage (10 km): trek through the deep jungle to Campamento Adán, with a rest stop. Final stage (8 km): open trails with little shade, where staying hydrated is crucial. Upon arriving at El Mamey, a celebration lunch awaits us to share the experiences lived. Transportation back to Santa Marta. Estimated arrival time: between 3:00 p.m. and 6:00 p.m.

Includes: 4×4 transport, travel insurance, local guides, optional indigenous guide and interpreter, fruit and snacks during breaks, accommodation and meals for 4 days.

Does not include: Alcoholic beverages, mineral water, handicrafts, flights.

5.title: Ecotopia Wimake Expedition 3 Days
5.description: 3 days of adventure, countryside knowledge, and ancestral exchange in the Sierra Nevada jungle. Living with Wiwa communities and hidden waterfalls.
5.longDescription:
Disconnect from your routine and venture into the Sierra Nevada jungle. Ecotopia awaits you with 27 hectares of waterfalls, mountains, and wild trails ready to be explored, accompanied by the unique value of living with and learning directly from local communities. In the hands of our countryside hosts, you will discover the secrets of artisanal beekeeping, panela production, and organic coffee and cacao farming; then venture into the sacred territory of the Wiwa indigenous community in Wimake.

DAY 1 | Immersion and Disconnection in Ecotopia
At 06:00 AM, the expedition begins from the hotel in a minivan. A 2.5-hour drive to El Escudo, where we will have a delicious breakfast. At 09:00 AM, we begin a hike to meet our first host, where we will learn about the artisanal process of panela and sugarcane honey. At 11:00 AM, meeting with our second host from the farming community to learn about the daily life of a coffee farmer and the organic coffee process from start to finish. At 12:30 PM, arrival at Ecotopia. Welcome with local herbal infusion, accommodation, and first contact with the 27 hectares of natural reserve. Conscious lunch with local ingredients. Guided exploration hike through the wild trails to hidden waterfalls. Time to bathe and purify in mountain waters. Artisanal dinner and campfire under the stars to set the intention for the journey. Night 1 in Ecotopia.

DAY 2 | On-Foot Journey to the Wimake Indigenous Village
Energizing breakfast. Start of the adventure hike connecting Ecotopia with the Wimake village. We will traverse mountain paths, dense vegetation, and river crossings, experiencing the territory in its purest form. Arrival at the Wimake village. Welcome by Wiwa authorities and families. Traditional lunch prepared by the community. Respectful tour of the village to learn about their straw and mud houses, traditional architecture, and the making of the mochila weave. Community dinner. Word circle and listening around the fire with local elders to learn about nature protection and the cosmovision of the Sierra Nevada. Night 2 in Wimake.

DAY 3 | Return to Origin and Experience Closing
Dawn with the sounds of the village and the jungle. Traditional breakfast with the Wiwa community and gratitude space. Return on muleback to recreate the daily life of the Wimake community. Arrival at the shield of the Tagua village. Integration lunch and free time before returning to the city.

Includes: Minivan transport, full meals (3 breakfasts, 3 lunches, 2 dinners), accommodation in Ecotopia and Wimake, local guide, cultural experiences with farming and Wiwa communities.

Does not include: Alcoholic beverages, mineral water, handicrafts, flights.

6.title: Wimake Village Trek 1 Day
6.description: One day of intense adventure through the tropical jungle to the Wiwa indigenous village of Wimake. Challenging trek and purification at the Guachaca River.
6.longDescription:
Do you have an explorer's spirit and are looking to test your physical endurance? The Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta not only holds ancestral secrets, but also demanding routes reserved for true adventurers. We challenge you to leave your comfort zone and venture into the thick tropical jungle on an intense, vibrant, and fascinating one-day tour to Wimake, a settlement of the Wiwa indigenous community. Guided by members of the community itself, you will make your way through irregular ancestral trails where each step demands energy, concentration, and deep respect for the imposing geography of the mountain.

DAY 1 | Immersion and Disconnection in Wimake
At 06:30 AM, pickup in Santa Marta and transfer by 4×4 vehicle to the foothills of the Sierra Nevada. At 08:00 AM, arrival at the starting point. Breakfast, warm-up, final technical instructions, and entry into the tropical humid forest. At 11:00 AM, after overcoming the demanding route, we reach the sacred village of Wimake. Time to rest and hydrate. At 11:30 AM, cultural immersion: exchange with the Wiwa community, talk about their cosmovision, and tour of the traditional architecture of the settlement. At 12:30 PM, traditional lunch to replenish the calories burned during the ascent. At 01:30 PM, short hike to the Guachaca River for an ice-cold swim and revitalization in its crystal-clear waters. At 02:30 PM, technical ascent: start of the return trek, facing the irregular terrain with a new perspective. At 05:00 PM, arrival at the 4×4 vehicle and start of the return journey. At 07:30 PM, return to Santa Marta.

Includes: 4×4 transport, breakfast and lunch, Wiwa community guide, cultural experience in Wimake.

Does not include: Alcoholic beverages, mineral water, handicrafts, flights.

7.title: Sacred Lagoon Adventure 5 Days
7.description: 5 days to the most sacred territory of the Caribbean. Expedition to the high lagoons of the Sierra Nevada, between 3,500 and 4,200 meters above sea level.
7.longDescription:
The adventure calls you to the most sacred territory of the Caribbean. Join our 5-day, 4-night expedition to the high lagoons of the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, a majestic setting where the mountain meets the sky. Walking these trails requires physical preparation, but above all humility and respect. For the native ethnic groups, every lagoon, river, and stone possesses a living spirit. Our commitment is to travel as conscious guests: minimizing our impact, honoring their traditions, and respecting the silence of the mountain.

DAY 1 | Ascent to Campamento Mil Estrellas
At 05:00 AM, 4×4 vehicle trip lasting approximately 3 hours from Santa Marta to the first meeting point in Ciénaga (65 km, 1,400 m.a.s.l.). At 08:00 AM, breakfast. At 09:00 AM, start of the ascent to 2,600 m.a.s.l. An 11 km hike lasting 6 to 8 hours to reach the first camp known as "Mil Estrellas" (Thousand Stars). Along the way you can observe natural attractions, lookouts, dense vegetation, water springs, bird watching, and possible close encounters with indigenous communities. Intermediate snacks, lunch, and dinner at the camp.

DAY 2 | Ascent to the Sacred Lagoons
At 06:00 AM, breakfast. At 07:00 AM, continue the ascent to 3,600 m.a.s.l. on a 12 km hike between 6 and 8 hours. On this route you can observe abundant flora and fauna of the sub-paramo and paramo. Intermediate snacks, hydration, and lunch during the journey. Arrival at the Sacred Lagoons that give birth to the Sevilla River, with their magical colors. Dinner at the camp.

DAY 3 | Lagoon Exploration
At 07:00 AM, breakfast. At 08:00 AM, visit to the lagoon surroundings. We can visit 3 main lagoons out of 7 located in this paramo, at an altitude of 3,500 to 4,200 m.a.s.l. with a viewpoint to Nevado Pico Cristóbal Colón. On this route we can observe the Andean Condor (emblematic bird), the Oxypogon Cyanolaemus (endemic), among others. Lunch and hydration. Dinner.

DAY 4 | Descent to Campamento Mil Estrellas
At 07:00 AM, breakfast. At 08:30 AM, return along the same ascent trail in 5 to 7 hours to reach camp "Mil Estrellas". Intermediate snacks, lunch, and dinner at the camp.

DAY 5 | Return to Santa Marta
At 06:00 AM, breakfast. At 07:00 AM, descent of 5 to 7 hours where transportation awaits us. Lunch at a typical regional restaurant. At 03:00 PM, return to Santa Marta.

Includes: Round-trip 4×4 transport, indigenous community permits, contributions, food and drinks on specified days, local guides, food preparation in camping area, night at "Mil Estrellas" accommodation, mule for luggage.

Does not include: Alcoholic beverages, trekking poles, services not identified in the tour.
